references.name: Center Street Bridge area
references.coordinateRole: USGS water-sampling monitoring location near bridge, not bridge span center
references.coordinateMethod: USGS reports map-interpolated point, accuracy plus or minus one arcsecond

references.name: Columbus Road Bridge area
references.coordinateRole: US Coast Guard published east-bank reference point at Columbus Road bridge; not independently surveyed span center
references.coordinateMethod: USCG DMS east-bank reference, converted to decimal degrees

limitations: These two locations are nearby references and not surveyed navigational bridge centerlines.
A vessel's proximity does not prove a bridge opening, clearance or passage, and is not a real-time prediction.
River miles describe legal bridge sequence but do not constitute a navigable route or pedestrian access.
A short observation interval around a reference point is not a validated bridge ETA.
